api_rate_limits: Service-role only table: counters written by edge functions via consume_rate_limit(). No anon/authenticated access; revoke all is set in the creating migration. A user-facing policy would be a security hole.
config_audit_log: Admin-only audit trail written by triggers and service-role functions. Users must never read or write audit records directly; access is via admin dashboard backed by service-role credentials.
dead_letter_messages: Internal ops table: failed worker messages queued for reprocessing. Readable and writable only by the service role and ops workers. No end-user access path exists or should be created.
refunds: Refund records are created and managed by the Stripe webhook handler (service role). Users view refund status through the bookings endpoint, not this table directly. Direct user access is intentionally blocked.
country_feature_flags: Read-only configuration data managed by admins. Exposed to authenticated users through a service-role edge function that enforces country scoping. Direct table access is intentionally not granted.
country_services: Read-only service availability config managed by admins. Surfaced to users via edge function with country scoping. Direct user reads are intentionally blocked to prevent enumeration.
pricing_zones: Pricing configuration managed by admins and exposed through the fare-calculation edge function (service role). Direct table access would allow users to enumerate zone shapes and pricing rules.
route_restrictions: Cross-border restriction rules managed by admins. Enforced server-side during trip creation. Direct user access is intentionally blocked to prevent restriction enumeration.
api_logs: Internal request log written by edge functions using the service role. Contains sensitive headers and tokens; never exposed to end-users. Access is through the admin dashboard only.
audit_logs: Platform-wide audit trail written by database triggers (service role). Immutable by design; user access would allow log tampering. Readable only via admin dashboard.
backup_logs: Infrastructure backup records managed by ops automation. No end-user access path; read via admin tooling only.
business_accounts: Corporate account records managed via admin onboarding flow. Direct authenticated access would allow cross-account enumeration; served through the corporate edge handler instead.
campaigns: Marketing campaign records created and managed by admins. Exposed to users through a filtered edge endpoint; direct table access would allow enumeration of unpublished campaigns.
chat_media: Media attachment metadata written by the chat edge handler (service role). Users access files through signed storage URLs, not by querying this table directly.
corridor_analytics: Aggregated route analytics computed by the analytics worker. No PII; read by admin dashboards via service role. No end-user access path exists.
demand_forecasts: ML-generated demand predictions used for driver dispatch. Internal ops data; no end-user access path. Read by the matching worker via service role.
disputes: Dispute records managed by the ops team. Users submit disputes through the disputes edge handler which enforces ownership; direct table access is not granted.
driver_payouts: Payout records managed by the payments worker (service role). Drivers view payouts through the wallet edge endpoint, not this table directly.
error_logs: Runtime error records written by edge functions using the service role. Contains stack traces and internal details; never exposed to end-users.
health_checks: Infrastructure health probe records written by monitoring automation. No end-user access path; read via admin tooling only.
pricing_rules: Dynamic pricing rule configuration managed by admins. Enforced server-side during fare calculation; direct user access would allow enumeration of pricing logic.
processed_stripe_events: Stripe webhook idempotency table written by the webhook handler (service role). Prevents double-processing; no end-user access path exists or should be created.
promo_codes: Promo code definitions managed by admins. Codes are validated through the promo edge endpoint (service role); direct access would allow enumeration of unreleased codes.
referrals: Referral tracking records created by the referral edge handler. Users view referral status through the app; direct table access is not granted.
system_alerts: Platform alert records written by monitoring automation and ops. Surfaced to admins via dashboard; no end-user access path exists.
trip_analytics: Aggregated per-trip metrics computed by the analytics worker. Used for admin reporting; no end-user access path. Contains driver earnings details not for passenger view.
universities: University directory data seeded at deployment and updated by admins. Exposed to users through a public read-only edge endpoint; direct table writes are not permitted.
